title: KestrelCare Plan Sale Eligibility, Purchase Window and Coverage Start
content:
## Article 1 — Vehicle and plan options

A KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts plan is sold only on a vehicle whose model age and odometer at sale are within the plan's limits (the maximum model age and maximum odometer at sale of its coverage level), with a term and a deductible taken from the plan's options.

## Article 2 — Post-sale purchase window

A plan bought after the vehicle sale is sold no later than the last day of the post-sale purchase window counted from the vehicle handover date. The window is counted in calendar days with the handover date as day 0 and includes its last day; after it the plan is not offered.

- **Clock start:** the vehicle handover date on the purchase order of the vehicle the plan is sold on. The handover date is taken from the purchase order record, matched by that order's number, not from the customer's recollection.
- **Length:** the coverage level's post-sale purchase window in calendar days.
- **Comparison:** the plan sale date must be not later than the last day of the window; the last day itself qualifies.

| Plan sale date counted from the handover date (90-day window) | Plan offered |
|---|---|
| day 0 (the handover date) | yes |
| day 90 | yes, last day of the window |
| day 91 | no |

*Hypothetical dates:* with a handover on 1 March and a 90-day window, day 90 is 30 May. A plan sale on 30 May is within the window; on 31 May the plan is not offered.

## Article 3 — Start of coverage

A plan sold with the vehicle starts coverage at handover with no waiting period. A plan bought later starts at the later of the sale date plus the waiting period days and the odometer at sale plus the waiting period miles.

*Hypothetical plan bought later:* sold on 10 March at 41200 miles with a 30-day and 1000-mile waiting period, its coverage cannot start before 9 April and cannot start before the odometer reaches 42200; it starts when the later of the two is reached.

## Article 4 — Including the plan in a finance contract

A plan may be included in the amount financed only when it is sold with the vehicle on a Kestrel Auto Finance purchase and the finance tier's back-end limit allows it. A plan bought after the vehicle sale is not included in the amount financed.
